caps.name: binary_tumor_classification
caps.description: Classify a 30-dim breast-cancer feature vector as malignant (0) or benign (1) using the frozen XGBoost model.

features.description: 30-dim float vector in load_breast_cancer schema order (mean radius ... worst fractal dimension)

caps.failure_boundary: Fails or returns unreliable output if features length != 30, non-numeric values, or values far outside training scale/distribution; no schema validation or confidence is returned.

caps.name: class_probability_estimation
caps.description: Return per-class probabilities for a 30-dim feature vector, enabling confidence-aware diagnosis.
caps.failure_boundary: Same input-shape/scale constraints as predict; probabilities are uncalibrated and may be overconfident on out-of-distribution inputs.

caps.name: feature_importance_explanation
caps.description: Report the top-k most important features by XGBoost gain importance, giving global model interpretability.

top_k.description: Number of top features to return

output_schema.description: Ordered list of top-k feature names/importances by gain

caps.failure_boundary: top_k outside [1,30] or non-integer may error or return fewer than requested; importance is global, not per-instance, so it does not explain individual predictions.

caps.name: class_label_discovery
caps.description: Return the class labels the model was trained on, allowing an agent to map numeric outputs to semantic labels.
caps.failure_boundary: Static metadata; fails only if the model artifact cannot be loaded.
